{"bullets":[{"text":"The page is rewritten from a search-engine privacy explanation into a company privacy policy. It now describes DuckDuckGo as an independent company since 2008 whose apps and extensions protect browsing, email, chatbots, and other apps, not only search. The founder's statement that he personally wrote the policy is removed.","citations":[{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"DuckDuckGo does not collect or share personal information."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"DuckDuckGo (officially, Duck Duck Go, Inc.) has been an independent company since our founding in 2008."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"our apps and extensions now offer protection well beyond search, including when browsing the web, reading email, using chatbots, and even using other apps."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"I (Gabriel Weinberg) am the founder of Duck Duck Go and personally wrote this privacy policy."}]},{"text":"The old absolute claim of not collecting or sharing personal information, and of not logging browser-sent data such as IP address at all, is replaced by a narrower practice: search, chat, and browsing history are not saved or shared, and search results are described as anonymous. Anonymous search queries, disconnected from identifiers such as IP addresses, are still saved to improve search indexes. Device information is used temporarily to deliver content and for security, and IP addresses that could be tied back to you are never logged to disk. Local search uses a random nearby location that is also not logged to disk. Hosting and content providers may receive anonymous browser and device types, but not information that could tie searches, chats, or visits to you. The old \"no cookies are used by default\" statement is replaced by anonymous cookies for settings and local storage for display settings.","citations":[{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"we do not log (store) it at all."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"At DuckDuckGo, no cookies are used by default."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"save or share your search, chat, or browsing history when you search on DuckDuckGo, chat on Duck.ai, or use our apps and extensions."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"viewing search results on DuckDuckGo is anonymous."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"completely disconnected from any unique identifiers like IP addresses"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"to improve our search indexes by analyzing anonymous search trends"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"we only use this information temporarily to deliver content to you and, for security, to ensure"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"never log IP addresses to disk that could be tied back to you"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"sends us a random location nearish to you, which we also never log to disk."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"we never share any information with them that could tie your searches, chats, or website visits to you personally"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"We offer a variety of settings that use anonymous cookies for storage"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"we use local storage on your device for anonymous display settings."}]},{"text":"The detailed default protection against \"search leakage\" (redirects so clicked sites do not receive search terms), the Tor exit enclave, and !proxy routing are no longer described. The new policy says other websites' policies apply if you open them directly, click external links, or use !bang shortcuts, and gives Facebook as an example of a site that will know what you do there. Apps and extensions are said to add safeguards, including Smarter Encryption for more encrypted connections on other sites.","citations":[{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"DuckDuckGo prevents search leakage by default."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"we decided to take the redirect approach to combat search leakage."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"DuckDuckGo actually operates a Tor exit enclave, which means you can get end to end anonymous and encrypted searching using Tor & DDG together."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"You can enter !proxy domain into DuckDuckGo as well, and we will route you through a proxy"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"when you visit other websites by navigating to them directly, by clicking external links on our search engine, or by using our !bang shortcuts, the privacy policies and practices of those other websites apply"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"if you browse Facebook, Facebook will know what you do on their site."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"our Smarter Encryption also helps you use more encrypted connections when visiting other websites."}]},{"text":"The affiliate-code revenue description (codes on sites such as Amazon and eBay, no third-party insertion, and no personally identifiable information via those programs) is gone. The new policy says DuckDuckGo makes money from private search ads based on the results page rather than a profile of you, and that ad clicks are managed by Microsoft, which has committed not to associate ad-click behavior with a user profile or to store or share it except for accounting.","citations":[{"hunk":"h1","side":"removed","quote":"we may add an affiliate code to some eCommerce sites (e.g. Amazon & eBay)"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"We make money through private search ads."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"It is a myth that search engines need to track you to make money."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"search ads on DuckDuckGo are based on the search results page"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"not based on you as a person"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"Ad clicks are managed by Microsoft"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"not associate your ad-click behavior with a user profile and to not store or share that information other than for accounting purposes."}]},{"text":"Optional features may now require limited personal information, used only for that feature. Information you send directly (newsletter, support, feedback) is kept only as long as needed and deleted when no longer required unless law requires longer; a newsletter address is deleted on unsubscribe. Those communications may be accessible to corporate software vendors.","citations":[{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"We offer optional privacy-protecting features that require limited personal information to function."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"For optional features, we only request personal information necessary for the feature to function and only use the information for that purpose."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"Email Protection is an optional feature that requires your email address to function"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"We take the same approach with other optional features like Duck.ai, Sync & Backup, and our DuckDuckGo Subscription"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"storing chats in encrypted form on our servers with Sync & Backup"},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"the master decryption key exists only on your synced devices, meaning DuckDuckGo cannot decrypt and read your chats in any case."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"deleting it when it is no longer required, unless a longer period is required by law."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"You can also unsubscribe at any time, at which point we will delete it."},{"hunk":"h1","side":"added","quote":"your communication may be accessible to the software-as-a-service providers we use in our corporate systems (such as our company email, project management software, and customer support vendors)."}]},{"text":"On legal requests, the old policy said DuckDuckGo would comply with court orders but expected to have nothing useful because it collected no personal information.
